reviews.t: I'm using these to make my own personal perfume from essential oils for my purse.
reviews.x: Exactly what I thought it would be.  I ordered a different set before, and they weren't dark enough. These were dark enough, could be darker but better than most.  The roller part worked easily. It was hard to push the top in, but I want it that way so it doesn't leak in my purse.

I started out loving these bottles and was just going to purchase more. I made six concoctions all at the same time and 2 of the rollers don't roll and are useless. I took them off to see if something was broken, but everything was in tact. Now, if I try to send it back, I will lose the expensive oil I put in the bottle. I hope to get a hold of the seller and see if they will send me 2 replacement rollers.
Unfortunately these roller balls are unusable. as hard as I've tried, I cannot get the roller ball part to actually roll! Barely any oil is applied because it is so stiff.
Good quality & easy to fill and assemble, but only comes with 4 roller ball tops! What's the point of selling 6 bottles with only 4 tops? Will not order again.

I was so excited for these to arrive--my first roller bottles with a metal roller ball (instead of plastic). However, they leak. It doesn't actually "drip" out or anything, but too much oil comes out of the top if you tip it to apply. Now I have a mess every time I open them. I have to have a paper towel handy. I have used 3 so far with the same result. Disappointing.

reviews.t: Best roller balls I have tried
reviews.x: Love these bottles the best so far!  My first time getting ones with a metal ball.  I have tried many other brands, amber and blue with plastic rollers. Some have been fine, many leak and a few of the plastic balls have come out making the roller bottle useless.  NOT these bottles!!  Yeah!  They cost a little more, but are worth it!
I bought these to use with essential oils.  They leak around the roller, so too much comes out.  It pools around the inside of the cap when the bottles are not upright.  I would not recommend these.
Great product, no complaints. Easy to use, the rollerballs works well. I have been using these for about 3-4 weeks now and so far no problems.

I have purchased many of these now from this company (Mavogel). Delivery is always on time, the glass bottles are always securely wrapped and not one order has ever come broken or without their caps and metal rollerballs so far. My essential oils made with Fractionated Coconut Oil roll on smoothly and not messy. The rollerball fits securely and I don't have any problems manuvering it back out to refill the bottle. Caps go on tightly and I haven't had one yet that leaked. My husband and son like

Being new to essential oils these are the first roller bottles I have ordered.  I didn't really know what to expect and was delighted when they arrived because the quality is better than I imagined.  The rollers are very smooth and work great.  No complaints and will order another set.

This is my first purchase of roller bottles, so I don't know if my problem is these or roller bottles in general. I dilute an essential oil with coconut oil in this bottle, but if the bottle is not upright, the oil leaks out. It works and is fine at home, but I can't travel with it.

Work pretty good. I use them for essential oils. The weight/density of the oil definitely makes a difference in how well they roll, but I'm sure it would with any roller-ball. I would/will order them again if i need more.

reviews.t: Love these! I mix our essential oils with a ...
reviews.x: Love these! I mix our essential oils with a carrier oil so we can take then with us in easy to apply formula.  I always have a few in my purse
The roller balls fall out of most of them after a use.  Typical of what we see today for quality, in every aspect of this world.
Nice roller bottles but unfortunately two arrived with cracks. I probably could have returned them but didn't want the hassle.
These are perfect for organic perfumes made with essential oils! Love the size and ease of assembly. High quality!

reviews.t: the amber color is a film on the glass that easily scratches
reviews.x: the glass is not amber....the amber color is a film on the glass that easily scratches off

reviews.t: I ordered these because of the good reviews, and I am impressed with them
reviews.x: I ordered these because of the good reviews, and I am impressed with them. I filled them today with some perfume I made and the oil doesn't leak. The quality is great, dark amber is great for helping to avoid spoiling of natural products. The roller ball is stainless steel and feels nice against your skin (especially on a super hot day!). It was a little difficult to press into the bottle, but if you use a towel to avoid hurting your hand its fine. (It is a good thing because it means airtight!)

reviews.t: Incredibly dissatisfied with these and the amount of oil I have wasted in transferring all my recipes OUT of these bottl
reviews.x: If I could rate these a "0", I would.  The tops do NOT fit snugly on top of the bottles, which eventually leads to your precious essential oil blends leaking THROUGH the roller ball AND cap and into your purse or wherever you have them stored.....even if in an upright position.  Incredibly dissatisfied with these and the amount of oil I have wasted in transferring all my recipes OUT of these bottles and into Young Living's 5mL bottles with YL's rollerball tops.  I should have known...

reviews.t: The roller seems to work pretty well, but they do leak a little bit ...
reviews.x: These are my first roller bottles, so I have nothing else to compare them to.  The roller seems to work pretty well, but they do leak a little bit sometimes, so make sure you don't just throw it in your purse or set it down on something without making sure you have wiped off any excess.  Essential oils leaking out can definitely do some damage to painted surfaces.

I was disappointed when these arrived. They are not in a sealed manufacturers packaging. It looks as if the seller broke up a larger set to make this set. What makes me nervous is that the roller bottles are loose as well which means they were touched... I'm using with essential oils as a personal care item. I expected new in original packaging.

They work great, I love the metal rollers they work way better than plastic. However the bottles are not amber they have a film on them which will come off overtime. Not a big deal though since they still do what they should. I don't see the point in spending lots on rollers so these work for me!

reviews.t: These are great.. Plus I like how they are dark
reviews.x: I will be buying these again.  I know they are a bit more expensive than the plastic rollers but these are smooth and the oil actually comes out!!  Plastic roll ons I've gotten in the past have not been acceptable. These are great.. Plus I like how they are dark. Oil comes out smooth.

reviews.t: i LOVE them- they are the perfect size for a larger ...
reviews.x: I bought these to blend my YLEO singles into blends for all sorts of uses.  i LOVE them- they are the perfect size for a larger blend to use daily. i have already bought more bottles because i've made so many oil blends!!

reviews.t: One of my favorite colors is why I chose this particular bottle
reviews.x: One of my favorite colors is why I chose this particular bottle.  I have used two of these bottles with my fractured coconut oil and essential oils mixing them and have been extremely please with the results.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the roller balls work smoothly and the bottles are easy to use and fill.
A common complaint is that the bottles leak or dispense too much oil when tipped or not kept upright.
Several reviewers report defective roller balls that don't roll or fall out, making the bottles unusable.
Some reviewers praise the overall quality and secure packaging, with no breakage or missing parts on arrival.
A few reviewers received incomplete sets or damaged bottles, such as missing roller tops or cracked glass.
